what: Live renders through the real backend code path (python -m cinema.cli render) against Comfy Cloud, run from server/.
key_source: COMFY_API_KEY_FILE -> ~/.aither/comfy_api_key; the key is never printed, logged or written into this repo
credits: no job response carried a credit count; none recorded

renders.command: python -m cinema.cli render --mode t2v --engine wan_t2v --width 480 --height 832 --frames 49 --steps 4 --seed 5 --prompt "Rain streaks across a rain-soaked rooftop at dusk, city lights below, a lone traveller in a long coat" --out ../docs/proof/wan_t2v_draft.mp4
renders.note: this is the render that proves the ModelSamplingSD3 shift correction (5.0 for the 4-step t2v LoRA path)

verified: each output was probed with ffprobe for width/height/frame count

frames were extracted and looked at: the camera draft shows a real dolly-in (the traveller is measurably larger at f048 while the city stays intact), the i2v draft turns the subject to face the lens, the ltx draft renders rain over a skyline
keyframe_draft.png and ltx_t2v_draft.mp4 are byte-identical to the media the backend stored for their shots
bugs_found_by_proving: geometry overrides (width/height/frames/steps) were dropped for every image-mode shot -- a 480x832/49 request rendered 480x480/33
the LOW expert re-read the original latent instead of the HIGH expert's output, so every Wan clip decoded to a flat field (cinema/graphs.py _wan_samplers)

WanImageToVideo / WanFirstLastFrameToVideo were fed a CLIP_VISION (loader) where they require a CLIP_VISION_OUTPUT (an encode) -- a hard validation error on wan_i2v, and an input name that does not exist on the plain i2v/flf2v graphs
ModelSamplingSD3 shift was 8.0 everywhere; the official lightx2v 4-step t2v/i2v graphs and the plain 20-step graphs use 5.0 (only Fun Camera uses 8.0)
provenance: docs/proof/provenance/shots.json holds the backend's own shot records (graph, seed, timings) for all four renders
